api_endpoints.description: Kiểm tra trạng thái hệ thống và Redis

patterns: Client-Server architecture with centralized analysis engine
Sublabel-aware HTML parsing to avoid brand/disease name collision
Serverless-friendly session management using Upstash Redis
gotchas: VNCDC Portal uses sublabels for disease names which must be stripped for brand-matching
Vercel sub-directory deployments require 'Root Directory' setting and relative paths in vercel.json
Upstash Redis REST API is preferred for serverless to avoid connection pooling issues
